title: Kamado Cover 80 × 102 cm – Protection with Storage Bag
seo_title: Kamado Cover 80 × 102 cm – With Storage Bag
seo_description: Kamado cover in black 600D fabric, 80 × 102 cm, with vent, four buckle straps and drawstring. Top handle and storage bag included.
descriptionHtml:
The rain runs down into the vent and the lid freezes shut in winter

The heavy ceramic grill stays outside year-round because it's too unwieldy to move indoors, and the rain finds its way straight down into the vent on top. Next time you want to grill you're met by a lid that has frozen shut and has to be knocked loose before you can get to the charcoal.

A cover in 600D fabric with a vent and storage bag

The cover in black 600D fabric measures 80 × 102 cm and has a handle on top, a vent opening, four buckle straps and a drawstring at the bottom edge. A storage bag is included.

Features

  • Rain is kept off the lid and the vent – the 600D cover, 80 × 102 cm, covers the whole grill.
  • Measure the grill before you buy – the cover is 80 cm wide and 102 cm tall.
  • Stays put around the base in wind – four buckle straps and a drawstring at the bottom edge hold the cover in place.
  • Lifts off with a handle and goes away in its own bag – the handle is on top and the storage bag is included.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

The grill is not included, only the cover.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
